integ.keysHint: One key per system (ERP, BI), with per-entity permissions, expiry and allowed IPs.
integ.confirmRevoke: Revoke key “{name}”? It stops working immediately.
integ.confirmDelete: Permanently delete key “{name}”? If active, it stops immediately. The request log is kept.
integ.copyNow: Copy it now: for security it will not be shown again.
integ.keyNameHint: A name that tells which system uses it, e.g. “ERP sync” or “Power BI”.
integ.errNoPerm: Grant access to at least one entity.
integ.expiryHint: After expiry the key is rejected automatically (401 key_expired).
integ.ipsHint: One per line, IP or CIDR range (e.g. 10.20.0.0/16). Empty = from anywhere.
integ.shownOnce: The key is shown only once after creation. Store it somewhere safe (e.g. in your ERP settings).
integ.errIp: Invalid IP or CIDR in the list.
integ.errExpiry: The expiry date must be in the future.
integ.rotateIntro: A new key with the same settings is created. Choose how long the old one keeps working, so you can switch your ERP without downtime.
integ.grace_1: Old key works for 1 more hour
integ.grace_24: Old key works for 24 more hours (recommended)
integ.grace_168: Old key works for 7 more days
integ.whHint: SoftifyOS notifies your system (ERP, Zapier, n8n) as soon as something changes, HMAC-signed with automatic retries.
integ.confirmRotateSecret: Generate a new signing secret? The old one stops immediately; update the receiving system.
integ.confirmDeleteWebhook: Delete webhook “{name}” and its delivery history?
integ.secretHint: Your system uses this secret to verify the X-Softify-Signature header (see Docs).
integ.whUrlHint: Receives a JSON POST. Success = a 2xx answer within 10 seconds.
integ.errWebhook: Check the URL and the events.
integ.whSignedHint: After creating it you will see the signing secret (HMAC-SHA256) used to verify the calls.
integ.logHint: Every API call with its result, duration and per-record errors.
integ.failedN: {count, plural, one {# record failed} other {# records failed}}
integ.rule6: Per-entity permissions: a key without access gets 403 forbidden; outside the allowed IPs 403 ip_not_allowed; after expiry 401 key_expired.
integ.rule7: Every call is recorded in the “Request log” for 30 days, with per-record errors.
integ.docWhHint: Instead of polling the API, SoftifyOS POSTs to your URL as soon as something changes.
integ.whRule2: Answer 2xx within 10 s. Otherwise it is retried after 30 s, 2 min, 10 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 12 h.
integ.whRule3: source tells who made the change (user / api / customer): ignore changes made by your own key to avoid loops.
integ.whRule4: The same event may arrive twice: use the id (X-Softify-Delivery) to ignore duplicates.
integ.docLists: Value lists (prefectures, categories, payment terms, zones…)
integ.rule8: Value lists: GET /api/v1/lists for all lists, GET/PUT /api/v1/lists/{list} for values; a rename (rename_from) also updates the records.
